title: App and notifications
lead: Use briefluence like an app and get notified right away.

install.title: Add to your Home Screen
install.installed: Done: you’re using briefluence as an app.

ios.s2: Tap Share (the square with an arrow).
ios.s3: Choose “Add to Home Screen”, then Add.
ios.s4: Open briefluence from your Home Screen.

android.s2: Tap “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.

install.desktop: In Chrome or Edge, click the install icon in the address bar or choose “Install briefluence” in the menu. In Safari on a Mac: File → Add to Dock.

banner.install: Add briefluence to your Home Screen to get notified about replies and new requests.
banner.push: Turn on notifications so you don’t miss replies and new requests.

push.label: Push notifications on this device
push.off: Get notified about replies, accepted applications and new requests, even when briefluence is closed.
push.on: On. Notifications will come to this device.
push.needsInstall: On iPhone and iPad, add briefluence to your Home Screen first (see above), open it from there, then turn this on.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser or phone settings, then come back.
push.unsupported: This browser can’t show push notifications. Try Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
